Provides a resource to create a CDN domain.

> **NOTE:** To disable most of configuration with switch, just modify switch argument to off instead of remove the whole block

```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.cdn.Domain("example", {
    domain: "example.com",
    serviceType: "web",
    area: "mainland",
    fullUrlCache: false,
    origin: {
        originType: "ip",
        originLists: ["127.0.0.1"],
        originPullProtocol: "follow",
    },
    httpsConfig: {
        httpsSwitch: "off",
        http2Switch: "off",
        ocspStaplingSwitch: "off",
        spdySwitch: "off",
        verifyClient: "off",
        forceRedirect: {
            "switch": "on",
            redirectType: "http",
            redirectStatusCode: 302,
        },
    },
    tags: {
        hello: "world",
    },
});
```

### Example Usage of COS bucket url as origin

<div>
<pulumi-chooser type="language" options="csharp,go,typescript,python,yaml,java,hcl"></pulumi-chooser>
</div>
<div>
<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="javascript,typescript">

```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const bucket = new tencentcloud.cos.Bucket("bucket", {
    bucket: "demo-bucket-1251234567",
    acl: "private",
});
// Create cdn domain
const example = new tencentcloud.cdn.Domain("example", {
    domain: "example.com",
    serviceType: "web",
    area: "mainland",
    cacheKey: {
        fullUrlCache: "off",
    },
    origin: {
        originType: "cos",
        originLists: [bucket.cosBucketUrl],
        serverName: bucket.cosBucketUrl,
        originPullProtocol: "follow",
        cosPrivateAccess: "on",
    },
    httpsConfig: {
        httpsSwitch: "off",
        http2Switch: "off",
        ocspStaplingSwitch: "off",
        spdySwitch: "off",
        verifyClient: "off",
    },
});
```
</pulumi-choosable>

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/cdn"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/cos"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		bucket, err := cos.NewBucket(ctx, "bucket", &cos.BucketArgs{
			Bucket: pulumi.String("demo-bucket-1251234567"),
			Acl:    pulumi.String("private"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		// Create cdn domain
		_, err = cdn.NewDomain(ctx, "example", &cdn.DomainArgs{
			Domain:      pulumi.String("example.com"),
```

            title="Required">
        <span id="cachetime_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#cachetime_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Cache<wbr>Time</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Cache expiration time setting, the unit is second, the maximum can be set to 365 days.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="comparemaxage_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#comparemaxage_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Compare<wbr>Max<wbr>Age</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Advanced cache expiration configuration. When it is turned on, it will compare the max-age value returned by the origin site with the cache expiration time set in CacheRules, and take the minimum value to cache at the node. Valid values are <code>on</code> and <code>off</code>. Default value is <code>off</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="followoriginswitch_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#followoriginswitch_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Follow<wbr>Origin<wbr>Switch</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Follow the source station configuration switch. Valid values are <code>on</code> and <code>off</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="heuristiccacheswitch_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#heuristiccacheswitch_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Heuristic<wbr>Cache<wbr>Switch</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify whether to enable heuristic cache, only available while <code>followOriginSwitch</code> enabled, values: <code>on</code>, <code>off</code> (Default).</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="heuristiccachetime_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#heuristiccachetime_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Heuristic<wbr>Cache<wbr>Time</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify heuristic cache time in second, only available while <code>followOriginSwitch</code> and <code>heuristicCacheSwitch</code> enabled.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="ignorecachecontrol_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#ignorecachecontrol_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Ignore<wbr>Cache<wbr>Control</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Force caching. After opening, the no-store and no-cache resources returned by the origin site will also be cached in accordance with the CacheRules rules. Valid values are <code>on</code> and <code>off</code>. Default value is <code>off</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="ignoresetcookie_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#ignoresetcookie_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Ignore<wbr>Set<wbr>Cookie</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Ignore the Set-Cookie header of the origin site. Valid values are <code>on</code> and <code>off</code>. Default value is <code>off</code>. This parameter is for white-list customer.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="nocacheswitch_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#nocacheswitch_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">No<wbr>Cache<wbr>Switch</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Cache configuration switch. Valid values are <code>on</code> and <code>off</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="revalidate_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#revalidate_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Re<wbr>Validate</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Always check back to origin. Valid values are <code>on</code> and <code>off</code>. Default value is <code>off</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="rulepaths_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#rulepaths_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Rule<wbr>Paths</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;string&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Matching content under the corresponding type of CacheType: <code>all</code>: fill *, <code>file</code>: fill in the suffix name, such as jpg, txt, <code>directory</code>: fill in the path, such as /xxx/test, <code>path</code>: fill in the absolute path, such as /xxx/test.html, <code>index</code>: fill /.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="ruletype_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#ruletype_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Rule<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Rule type. The following types are supported: <code>all</code>: all documents take effect, <code>file</code>: the specified file suffix takes effect, <code>directory</code>: the specified path takes effect, <code>path</code>: specify the absolute path to take effect, <code>index</code>: home page.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="switch_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#switch_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Switch</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Cache configuration switch. Valid values are <code>on</code> and <code>off</code>.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>

## Import



CDN domain can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cdn/domain:Domain example example.com
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
